name: Coin
desc: Wages from the mill and the ferry road. Twenty is all a loose purse carries.
flavor: Counted twice on the way home, as everyone in Lowbridge counts it.

name: Herbs
desc: Clean bundles for Granny Shu's stall, and the ten the Foundation sitting burns.

name: Timber
desc: Straight lengths for racks, frames and a roof of your own. Six is a full stack without a shed.

name: Channel stone
desc: Water-set stones that keep the shape the stream gave them.

name: Qi
desc: A reservoir gathered by the slip's breath method. Techniques spend it; the Foundation attempt wants it full and does not take it.

name: Attunement
desc: Methods held ready in the mind. Attuning a technique fills one place, and a technique must be held before it can be used.
flavor: You can remember reading a method and still be unable to use it.

events.text: Shu watches you sit through a whole morning's sorting without once fidgeting. ‘So it took,’ she says, and leaves a cup of something bitter by your bundles.

name: Vigor
desc: Strength for the day's chores. It comes back on its own whether you are busy or idle, and quicker still if you lie down to it.

name: Strain
desc: How much broken ground the body will take before it must turn back. Ridge outings draw it down; it returns slowly, busy or idle.

name: Focus
desc: How long attention holds on bad ground; outings draw it down and Rest brings it back. It returns slowly on its own, busy or idle.

name: Hobby
desc: A second place for a practice that runs at half pace beside whatever holds the activity slot, and keeps running while you are away. The Second Direction opens it.

name: Life
desc: What a blow takes before the body gives way. Only a fight draws on it. It returns slowly on its own, busy or idle, and from empty to full in about five minutes while you rest. Circulation deepens it.
flavor: Nobody in Lowbridge counts it until somebody swings at them.

name: Strike
desc: What a blow of yours carries. A strike lands for what it has over the other's guard.

name: Guard
desc: What a blow against you is turned by. Their strike lands for what it has over it.

name: Speed
desc: How often you swing. In a fight your readiness fills by your Speed each second, and you swing each time it reaches five: at Speed 1, every five seconds.

name: Hit
desc: Your chance, in percent, to put a swing where you meant it. The other's Dodge takes its share of what remains.

name: Dodge
desc: Your chance, in percent, to be elsewhere when a swing arrives. Nobody slips more than three in five.

name: Marrow herbs
desc: Bitter roots from the disturbed ground around the survey marker. The Body bill wants twelve, more than a new store holds.

name: Whetstone grit
desc: Fine grit cut from the inscription face. The Sword bill wants twelve, more than a new store holds.

name: Veined ore
desc: Ore that keeps the grain of the ground it came from. The Earth bill wants twelve, more than a new store holds.

name: Inked tokens
desc: Counters that hold a layout once it has been tested. The Formation bill wants twelve, more than a new store holds.

name: Walking staff
desc: A porter's staff cut to your height and kept by the door. While you carry it, everything that draws on Strain draws a fifth less.

name: Herb poultice
desc: Bruised herbs in a cloth, three to a batch. Bound on, one gives five Vigor back. Three keep.

name: Marrow tonic
desc: Marrow herbs steeped bitter. Drunk, one gives four of Life and two of Strain back. Three keep.

name: Honed edge
desc: A working blade brought to a true edge on whetstone grit. While you carry it, Strike reaches two higher.

name: Weighted stakes
desc: Survey stakes shod with veined ore, which hold a footing the ground would rather not give. While you carry them, Guard reaches one higher and Strain two.

name: Warding strip
desc: Inked tokens sewn into a strip worn at the wrist, a fixed layout that travels. While you wear it, Dodge reaches ten higher.

name: Pale root
desc: A white root from the bank the spur uncovers, bitter and cold. Refining holds two more per level; ten is a full basket without a still-room.

name: Settling draught
desc: Pale root steeped with ordinary herbs. Drunk, it keeps the body and the attention on bad ground for five minutes. Three keep at the bench.

name: Marrow draught
desc: Marrow herbs reduced over pale root. Drunk, the carrying drills and the scree run faster for five minutes. Three keep at the bench.

name: Clear pill
desc: Pale root rolled with a coin's worth of binder. Taken, it returns six qi and four Focus at once. Three keep at the bench.

name: Han's specimen case
desc: A fitted case with an inked token sewn into the lining, made to the keeper's measure. It is his once delivered.

name: Home space
desc: Spans of floor already in use. Arrangements come with you when the home grows.

name: Coin earned
desc: Every wage paid since you came to Lowbridge, raises included. Trades and bounties are not wages.

name: Lore
desc: The slip's surviving characters, and how many of them you can read.
flavor: Three leaves of twelve, and the cracks take a little more each year.

events.text: The carver's hand sorts itself out under your brush. Proper tools would let you go where the characters point.

name: Qi Sense
desc: Feeling where qi gathers and where it runs. Each level widens the reservoir and sharpens a held method.

events.text: Something that is not air moves under the breath, and it pulls two ways: toward the broken channel beyond the barns, and upstream to a hollow of ferns.
The faint pull from upstream has a shape now. Fernhollow can be sat in.

name: Circulation
desc: The slip's method, made whole enough to move qi through the body. Each level also deepens Life by two and adds one to Strike and Guard.
needtext: Channel stones set in the floor, or three dusks sat in Fernhollow.

events.text: The turn holds on its own for a breath. The method is whole enough to settle.

name: Blade Intent
desc: Meeting a blade's line with your own. From level 2 the carved face gives a measure more grit with every cut.

events.text: The post stops ringing when you meet it. On the carved face your edge finds the soft seams first, and a measure more of grit comes away with every cut.

name: Ground Reading
desc: Where the ground holds and where it slides. From level 2 the stable point gives a piece more ore each time.

events.text: Poured water runs where you guessed it would, three times running. Above the slide you start to see the ore before your foot finds it.

name: Array Craft
desc: Small fixed layouts that hold a place still. From level 2 a tested layout keeps a token more each time.

events.text: A layout on your floor holds through a whole night with nobody correcting it. On the ridge the next test keeps a token more.

name: Herb Lore
desc: Granny Shu's eye for a good bundle and a bad one.

name: Labour
desc: Sacks, timber and freight harden the back and teach it to pace itself.

name: Stone Sense
desc: How a stone sits in moving water, and where it will sit again.

name: Composure
desc: Stillness that outlasts the sitting.

name: Refining
desc: Drawing what a root holds out of it with an ordinary vessel and a careful fire. Each level holds two more pale root and steeps the draughts a tenth faster. From level 2 the pale-root bank gives a root more each dig.

name: Reading work
desc: Making out what someone wrote or cut: inscriptions, diagrams, old hands.

name: Porter's notes
desc: The teachings the porter wrote down for the ridge.

name: Qi watching
desc: Going somewhere and sitting still long enough to feel how qi moves there.

name: Draught-making
desc: Steeping and reducing herbs into draughts.

name: Foundation
desc: The reconstructed method holds without you watching it.

name: Faint trace
desc: A thread kept through stillness. It stays distinct from the channel's flow pattern.

name: The ridge waystation
desc: The old porters' waystation on Old Ridge, reached by the method you held. Its bad ground draws on Focus as well as Strain.

events.text: Keeper Han writes your name in the ledger and turns it round so you can read what is on the board beside it: route records toward the basin, a chime that rings at dusk, a spur that ends at a slide, and the slip's other nine leaves. ‘Any of them,’ he says. ‘All of them, if you stay.’

name: Surviving route records toward the Cloudwell basin
desc: The keeper's ledgers name a basin beyond the ridge.
needtext: The rise above the slide has not been climbed.

name: An unusual chime
desc: At dusk something rings once from higher up the ridge.
needtext: The chime has not been explained: sit it out, then test the relay stone.

name: The damaged spur
desc: A spur of the old path ends at a slide.
needtext: The slide on the spur has not been cleared; it wants a staff or shod stakes from the bench.

name: The slip's other nine leaves
desc: The keeper's oldest ledger lists a jade slip of twelve leaves, carried up the porters' path to be sold in the Cloudwell basin long before Shu was born. Six never went: three are the slip you hold, three stayed in Shu's family. The other six went up the path, and the ledger places only some of them.
needtext: Six of the nine are on the road: Shu's three, the relay keeper's, the shelter's and Han's.

name: The ferryman's leaf
desc: One of the three leaves the ledger could not place, down at the Cloudwell crossing.

name: The cistern's leaf
desc: One of the three leaves the ledger could not place, under Reedmarket itself.
needtext: The cistern under Reedmarket has not been walked to its dry gallery.

name: The far leaf
desc: The leaf the ledger only calls the far leaf; the porter only points at it.

name: Iron-bound coffer
desc: Room for two hundred more coin; enough to save for a cottage.

name: A cottage beyond the mill
desc: Eight spans of floor, a place to sleep, a place to practise and a place to study. The walls hold a little qi of their own. Arrangements move with you; the Lean-to closes when you move.

events.text: Wen helps carry your things across and stays longer than he needs to, one hand flat on the wall. ‘Warm for the season,’ he says, and does not ask why.

name: Reading desk
desc: Fills the place you study. Copying the slip goes half again as fast, and Lore can reach one level further.

name: Workbench
desc: One span of floor under the window: a bench, a vice and a mortar, with room to stack two more timber. What it makes is worked on the Craft tab; each recipe holds the activity slot while it runs.
needtext: Twenty coin, four timber and one free span of floor.

name: Take a First Direction
desc: Three minutes with the reconstructed method carried into whichever sphere you have brought to four: the loaded frame, the post, the stakes or a held layout. The bill is paid at the start; twelve of that sphere's material must be in hand and are not spent. It raises the cap of every sphere you carry at four, holds a fourth method ready, and afterwards the bank keeps up to a day of time away. It closes nothing.
needtext: Twelve of that sphere's material in hand: marrow herbs, whetstone grit, veined ore or inked tokens.

breakthrough.title: First Direction
breakthrough.core: g.circulation >= 4 && g.body_drills.reps > 0 || g.blade_intent >= 4 && g.blade_drills.reps > 0 || g.ground_reading >= 4 && g.ground_drills.reps > 0 || g.array_craft >= 4 && g.array_drills.reps > 0
breakthrough.coreLabel: A sphere carried to four, its drills begun: Circulation, Blade Intent, Ground Reading or Array Craft

pointers.label: A furnished home: a cot, a herb plot or a strongbox
A method of that school held and used: two of the body's, or one of the sword's, the earth's or formation's
Two hundred coin earned in wages

events.text: The load settles into the frame of the body itself. Body Disciple. The main approach no longer looks steep.
The post stops answering; the intent arrives before the blade. Sword Disciple. The side passage looks cuttable.
Under the knees the ground has a grain, and the grain has a direction. Earth Listener. A stable line runs up the ridge.
The tokens stop drifting and the air inside them stops too. Formation Student. A small array could turn the flow on the ridge.
